answer: Every identity must anchor to one unique household electricity meter: the utility fits a smart meter, and 90 days of continuous use must pass first, the ripple of daily consumption proving a real home. Hookup costs $300, the unit $120, and power $2 a day, so each fake costs $600 and 97 days, the kernel being the unbroken record; 100 fakes cost $60,000 and 9,700 days. The cheapest cheat is renting a metered room at $250 a month or bribing a reader $400 a meter, but one meter serves one identity, duplicates are rejected, and onyx-dark audits burn the whole cluster.
